source_snapshot.test_name: Network Validation Initial Environment Setup and trial run - Check Network Map
source_snapshot.purpose_facts: Generate IB traffic between node-1/node-2, configure UFM Link Analysis so Port RX Data Rate >100 Gb/s is yellow, and verify yellow link/property presentation.
procedure_facts: Requires interactive UFM view mutation and IB-Stress; 15-minute attended and machine time.
criteria_facts: RX threshold config saves without errors; links yellow; node properties yellow in Port TX/RX Data Rate.
source_conflicts: The configured condition names only Port RX Data Rate, but the final criterion expects yellow in a combined `Port TX/RX Data Rate` property; bidirectional traffic needed to trigger both endpoint RX values is not defined.
missing_source_information: Exact node/HCA/port/link map, IB-Stress direction/tool/rate/duration, UFM release/metric units/refresh/color scope and saved-view rollback.

original_test_intent.statement: Under controlled node-1/node-2 InfiniBand traffic, verify UFM Network Map correctly evaluates the configured >100 Gb/s Port RX threshold and presents yellow on the intended links and associated properties.
must_preserve: Node pair, UFM Network Map/Link Analysis, exact >100 Gb/s RX condition, yellow display and 15-minute activity.
must_not_infer: That a unidirectional run makes both endpoint RX ports exceed threshold.
That yellow itself means fabric health PASS beyond rule rendering.
That the threshold automatically applies to TX or a combined property.

v2_review_conclusion.summary: V2 preserves IB traffic, exact RX metric/threshold/yellow state, requires port mapping, bounded traffic, refresh wait, saved view and rollback.
v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: V2 does not expose the RX-only versus TX/RX display inconsistency or require a traffic-direction plan that independently makes each intended receiving port exceed 100 Gb/s.

related_records: Other IB throughput cases cannot define UFM color-rule propagation in this UI release.
applicable_history.precedence_application: Source threshold and UI outcomes are preserved, but the owner must resolve direction and combined-property semantics rather than V3 inventing them.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Resolve whether one RX rule is expected to color a combined TX/RX property and define traffic directions for both endpoint receive links. Then run bounded traffic, correlate raw counters to UFM refreshes and restore the saved view.

conditions_present: Exact UI area, RX threshold, color and node pair.
missing: Rule propagation semantics, per-direction traffic plan, port mapping, tool/rate/duration, refresh interval, view rollback and approval.
provider: UFM/fabric owner resolves UI semantics and map.
Lab owner supplies isolated pair, traffic plan and window.
safe_read_only_work: Export current UFM view/rules/topology, collect port GUID/LID/HCA/link mapping and baseline counters/alarms without load or edits.
prohibited_until_resolved: IB-Stress, UFM rule/view mutation, topology deployment, log clearing, interpreting yellow as health PASS or PASS.
closure_evidence: Signed RX-to-display behavior and direction/port/rate plan plus saved-view rollback and bounded stop.

revision_candidate.test_name: Verify UFM Network Map RX-Rate Yellow Rule Under Controlled IB Traffic
revision_candidate.purpose: Verify that UFM applies the configured `Port RX Data Rate > 100 Gb/s` yellow rule to the exact node-1/node-2 links and intended property display when independently measured receive traffic exceeds the threshold.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: The approved isolated InfiniBand fabric, UFM release/Network Map view, node-1/node-2 HCAs and port links. Ethernet/RoCE counters or a different UFM release cannot be assumed equivalent.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Only the signed physical/logical links between node-1 and node-2 and the corresponding UFM link/property objects. The owner must define whether traffic runs bidirectionally/simultaneously or sequentially so each intended RX port exceeds 100 Gb/s, and whether the RX rule should color a combined TX/RX property.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: UFM version/access and saved view/rules; node/HCA/port GUID/LID/link map; exact metric units/aggregation/refresh; owner decision on RX versus TX/RX display; approved IB-Stress/perftest command, message size/direction/rate/duration; independent traffic timeout/stop policy; isolation, rollback and evidence approval.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Export the current Network Map view/rules and baseline raw per-port TX/RX counters/alarms. Treat the source's 15 minutes as a planning estimate for the complete setup, bounded traffic, observation and rollback activity—not a required traffic dwell, hard timeout or acceptance criterion. Configure only the approved Link Analysis `Port RX Data Rate > 100 Gb/s` yellow rule. Run the finite owner-defined traffic direction(s) and duration so each designated receiving port crosses the threshold, correlate traffic-tool throughput and raw port counters to enough declared UFM refresh cycles to prove the transition, and capture the exact links and property fields before/during/after the condition. Stop all workers by the independent approved timeout/stop policy and restore the prior UFM view/rules.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Healthy mapped IB links; no unrelated jobs; UFM metric semantics and display decision resolved; traffic can exceed threshold safely; evidence clock synchronization, saved rollback, stop owner and approval ready.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: UFM version/view export and rule diff; topology/node/HCA/port identities; source 15-minute planning estimate plus owner-defined traffic duration, stop timeout and observed refresh count; exact traffic commands/directions/times/results; raw per-port RX/TX counters in matching units; UFM refresh timestamps and values; screenshots/API evidence for each targeted link and property below/above/after threshold; alarms/logs; worker stop and exact view restoration.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Owner-approved UFM rule behavior for this release. Pass requires the rule to save, every mapped receiving link with independently proven RX >100 Gb/s to turn yellow after the declared refresh, only the approved property representation to color as specified, below-threshold state not to falsely color, and full cleanup/rollback.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not guess direction/port, use production traffic, leave workers/rules active, deploy topology/subnet changes, overload neighboring links, clear logs, infer rate solely from color, assume TX/RX propagation or call yellow fabric health PASS.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Fabric owner approves ports/directions/rate/rule semantics and view edit; operator supervises UFM/traffic; engineer judges display/counter timing.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Traffic and counter capture can be automated; interactive UFM edit/visual evidence may require operator, and rule semantics remain owner-defined.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: On wrong port, rate/refresh mismatch, alarm, congestion or link degradation, stop traffic, preserve counters/UI state, restore exported rules/view, verify links/UFM/fabric health and escalate before retry.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: RX-versus-TX/RX semantics unresolved; ambiguous ports/direction; no isolation/rollback/stop; inability to reach threshold safely; wrong link colors; UFM/IB alarm; link degradation; orphan worker; incomplete counter-to-UI correlation.

identified_defects: RX-only rule conflicts with combined TX/RX expected display.
Traffic direction needed for both RX endpoints is undefined.
reason_for_change: Prevent a UI color demonstration from silently changing metric direction or becoming a substitute for measured link traffic.

new_technical_evidence.title: Source testcase Wistron-L12 Cluster-00005-V002
new_technical_evidence.supports: RX threshold, >100 Gb/s, yellow link and TX/RX property wording, node pair and 15-minute times.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: UFM release-specific rule propagation and traffic direction remain absent.

removed_ambiguities: Exposes RX versus combined TX/RX inconsistency.
Requires every target RX port to cross threshold by defined direction.
Correlates UI color to raw counter and refresh time.
resolved_blockers: UFM/traffic packages and user inputs are provisionable; not inherently BLOCKED.
remaining_blockers: Rule semantics, direction/port plan and approval must be supplied.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 detects the source's RX-only versus TX/RX display conflict and requires direction-specific raw counter evidence for each yellow link, eliminating a color-only or one-way false PASS.

agent_understanding_result.notes: Initial validation found ambiguous 15-minute semantics. Revalidation confirmed planning-only meaning, separate finite traffic duration/stop timeout, enough declared refresh cycles, direction-specific RX proof and exact rollback.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Compatibility row 423 configures RX >100 Gb/s yellow yet expects TX/RX property yellow for both nodes under IB-Stress.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_v2_comparison: V2 guards traffic/view; V3 adds direction and rule-propagation conflict handling.
per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: Only view/topology/counter baseline is safe before conflict resolution and traffic approval.
